name: reno-layouts
description: Edit measured layouts, research product specifications, export construction-stage diagrams and propose wall tile set-outs using the open Reno Layouts site's WebMCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Edit measured plans and research fixture specifications.
interface.longDescription: Four lean skills for the open Reno Layouts site: apply measured layout changes, submit sourced product specifications for human review, compose construction-stage diagrams and specification sheets, and propose a wall tile set-out with a printable elevation, all from the one project model. Requires a browser surface exposing the site's WebMCP tools and an open project. Product research also needs browsing or document-reading tools.
defaultPrompt: Apply my measured changes to the open Reno Layouts plan.
Research my named Reno Layouts product request.
Export stage diagrams for my Reno Layouts bathroom.
Set out the tiles on my Reno Layouts bathroom wall.
